meta.purpose: Everything that could not be confirmed from an official source, every value deliberately left blank, and every irregularity found while reverse-engineering OLBG. Nothing here blocks publication; it is the reviewer's queue.

items.detail: The NHL score feed lists 12 games for 22 October. Eleven were captured with both teams, venue and start time. The twelfth (at Climate Pledge Arena) was cut off mid-record, so the away team is unknown and the fixture is omitted rather than guessed.

items.item: San Jose Sharks goals for / against
items.detail: The Sharks' goals-for and goals-against did not appear inside the captured response window of the NHL team-summary endpoint. Their 2026-10-22 game at Ottawa therefore has no originated line; the row is published with blank goals data.

items.item: NBA Sacramento @ LA Clippers game id
items.detail: The official games page rendered the fixture but the game id was truncated in capture. The fixture is published; the game id is blank.

OLBG listed ATP/WTA matches (e.g. Leylah Fernandez v Aliaksandra Sasnovich, Adrian Mannarino v Andrey Rublev, Ekaterina Alexandrova v Marta Kostyuk). The official ATP rankings page renders its table client-side, so no ranking input could be read and verified; the tournament entry lists were not matched. Publishing probabilities would have required inventing an input.

OLBG listed 26+ PDC matches for 22-23 October. The PDC rankings page returned a cookie-consent shell rather than the Order of Merit table, and the tournament draw was not captured, so neither the fixtures nor a strength input could be verified.

World Snooker Tour confirmed two BetVictor Northern Ireland Open round-two matches at 05:00 (UK) on 21 October (Pang Junxu v Liam Davies; Cheung Ka Wai v Stuart Bingham). By capture time both had started, and the remaining four OLBG-listed matches were outside the captured page window. None were published as pre-match selections.

OLBG listed club matches (St Finbarrs v Nemo Rangers, Moycullen v Salthill-Knocknacarra, Rathgormack v The Nire). No official county-board page confirming these fixtures was captured, so they are not published as verified rows.

items.item: Rugby Union — Top 14 and Pro D2 not verified
items.detail: OLBG listed French league fixtures (e.g. Toulouse v Perpignan, Bayonne v Lyon, Montauban v Oyonnax). Only the United Rugby Championship could be verified against its official match centre; LNR fixtures were not captured.

items.item: Sports not surveyed in this capture
items.detail: Handball, Volleyball, Golf, Motor Racing, Greyhounds, eSports, Aussie Rules and Rugby League were not captured before the session closed. Absence from this site is NOT evidence that OLBG lists no events for them.

No verified 2025-26 points-for / points-against table was captured, so totals were left blank for all 11 NBA games rather than estimated. Moneyline and handicap were originated from the official prior-season record.

Two fixtures were confirmed on the ICC official match list (Afghanistan v Bangladesh ODI; New Zealand v India T20I). The ICC team-ranking table rendered empty, so no strength input existed and no line was originated.

items.item: OLBG displayed times do not map to one timezone
items.detail: NBA events show US-Eastern clock times roughly ten minutes after the official tip time (OLBG 19:10 vs NBA 19:00 ET for Milwaukee @ Washington). NHL events show UK clock times roughly seven minutes after the equivalent UK time (OLBG 00:37 vs an 00:30 UK face-off). The dataset stores OLBG strings verbatim and takes authoritative times from the league feed.

items.item: Cached fixtures on OLBG's global tips page
items.detail: The global /betting-tips page returned football fixtures that cannot exist in October 2026 (Champions League cards such as Real Madrid v RB Leipzig). Sport hub pages were internally consistent, so only hub pages were used for event discovery.

OLBG appends format labels to cricket fixtures (e.g. 'Afghanistan vs Bangladesh One Day Match') and abbreviates Gaelic football club names ('Eire Og Cor'). Canonical names in this dataset come from the official body.

Every NBA team playing on 21 October was 0-0 before tip-off, so the model uses the completed 2025-26 season as a prior. Confidence is therefore capped at 'medium' and no NBA pick is presented as high confidence.
The URC match centre states 'All times shown are Local'. Times are stored exactly as published and were not converted, so a reader in another timezone must apply the venue offset.

Lines are originated from 2026-27 season-to-date goal rates with empirical-Bayes shrinkage (k=8) and a 1.05 home-ice factor. Early-season rates are noisy; the shrinkage is the guard against overconfidence, not a correction for roster changes.

items.item: No OLBG odds were used or available
items.detail: OLBG hub pages publish tip percentages but no prices, and no bookmaker prices were used at any point. Every price in this dataset is generated from our own probability plus a 4% theoretical margin. They are not market prices.

items.item: NHL goal totals differ by shootout convention
items.detail: nhl.com/standings counts the shootout-deciding goal in GF/GA; api.nhle.com/stats/rest/en/team/summary does not. Over the same games Ottawa read 24 GF on standings vs 22 in the API (two shootout wins), Buffalo 34 GA vs 33 (one shootout loss) and Seattle 39 vs 37 (two shootout wins). Our inputs are captured from nhl.com/standings, so our rates sit up to ~0.2 goals per game above the stats-API view. Disclosed rather than adjusted, because the input is correct for its cited source. Found by a separate verification pass (PR #11).
